Now we are going to organize the data.frame: we are going to filter by timepoint and sex, reduce the data.frame selecting a few columns, create new columns named Tcells_ProportionCD45 and TcellsRounded with two significant digits, rearrange by descending values of this last column and select those data with TcellsRounded values higher than 0.4:

```{r}
Subset <- Data |> filter(timepoint %in% "4") |> filter (Sex %in% "Female") |> select(Specimen, timepoint, Condition, Date, Sex, Tcells_count, CD45_count) |> mutate(Tcells_ProportionCD45 = Tcells_count/CD45_count, TcellsRounded = round(Tcells_ProportionCD45, 2)) |> arrange(desc(TcellsRounded)) |> filter(TcellsRounded > 0.4)
Subset
```
